verses.1: Hazon Obadiah said, “As my Lord Jehovah has commanded, so we have heard from Him. The nations will be attacked, and they will be punished for their actions.”
verses.2: Look, you were given a small portion of land in these nations. You are indeed blessed.
verses.3: Your heart is full of deceit; you have made me a prisoner in the land of solitude. In your heart, you say, “Who will lead me to the land?”
verses.4: If it rises like a tower, and if among the stars there is someone who takes your goods from there, then say, “God!”
verses.5: If thieves come to you, or if night-time robbers attack you, how will you be able to protect yourself? If bandits come to you, how will you be able to keep them at bay?
verses.6: How were Esau and his descendants chosen from among his ancestors?
verses.7: Until your borders are destroyed, all your people from your covenant will be defeated. Your people, who are your children, will fall under your control. There will be no hope for you.
verses.8: On that day, the Lord will say, “And the wise men of Adam will be destroyed, and the plans of Esau will fail.”
verses.9: And your rulers shall be appointed for a time, so that no one may recognize Esau from his birth.
verses.10: From your brother Jacob’s descendants, you will be inherited by Ushah. And you will be marked forever as belonging to him.
verses.11: On the day you stood against them, on the day when foreigners and strangers came to their doors. In Jerusalem, their hands were raised against you as well, just like one of them.
verses.12: And do not rejoice on the day of your brother’s destruction. Do not celebrate with the hearts of the Jews on the day they are destroyed. And do not boast in yourself on the day of adversity.
verses.13: Do not enter my gate on the day of his death. Do not also appear in his presence on that day. And do not send any of your people into his army on the day of his death.
verses.14: And do not stand on the cross to destroy their victims. Do not bury their remains on the day of judgment.
verses.15: For the day of Jehovah is near for all nations, just as you have done. Your evil will be turned into good, and your sorrow will turn into joy.
verses.16: For when you stand on the Holy Mountain, all nations will always drink from it. They will drink and become drunk, just as they were before.
verses.17: And in Mount Zion, there will be a place of refuge. It will become holy, and the house of Jacob will inherit its blessings.
verses.18: And the house of Jacob will be like fire, and the house of Joseph will be like flame. And the house of Esau will be like ashes. They will burn up, and they will be consumed. There will be no survivors from the house of Esau, for Jehovah has spoken.
verses.19: And the Negeb will inherit Mount Esau. They will also inherit Philistia. They will also inherit the land of Ephraim and the land of Someron. And in Benjamin, they will inherit Gilad.
verses.20: And this beginning was revealed to the children of Israel. The Canaanites were defeated until they reached Syria. Jerusalem was also conquered by the Israelites; they took control of the cities in the Negev region.
verses.21: And they went up Mount Zion to judge Mount Esau. And it became the throne of Jehovah.
